field_changes.old: In this version, you can now reset your PRs to a new baseline, so every workout shows a reachable target while your full PR history stays safe. Also, it includes bug fixes and general improvements to the app for better user experience.
field_changes.new:
In this version, we're introducing some exciting new features:
- Community: a new social feed to follow your friends, share workouts, and stay motivated
- Save programs: tap Save on any coach or user program to bookmark it, then find them all in one tab
Plus bug fixes and general improvements to the app for better user experience.
